prompt: Create a Python 3.12 blog management application. Authors can create posts. Each post belongs to one author and can have multiple tags. A tag can be associated with multiple posts. Provide CRUD operations for authors, posts and tags, and allow posts to be searched by tag.

intentions.text: I can create a new author in the system.
intentions.requires: an author's name and email address
intentions.observable: the author is listed in the author directory with the provided name and email

intentions.text: I can create a new post associated with an author.
intentions.requires: a post title, content, and an author identifier
intentions.observable: the post appears in the list of posts, linked to the specified author

intentions.text: I can add a tag to a post.
intentions.requires: a post identifier and a tag name
intentions.observable: the tag appears in the list of tags associated with the post

intentions.text: I can view all posts belonging to a specific author.
intentions.observable: a list of posts is displayed, each belonging to the specified author

intentions.text: I can view all posts that have a specific tag.
intentions.observable: a list of posts is displayed, each tagged with the specified tag

intentions.text: I can update an existing post's title or content.
intentions.requires: a post identifier and new title/content
intentions.observable: the post's title or content is updated and reflected in the list of posts

intentions.text: I can delete a post from the system.
intentions.observable: the post is removed from the list of posts

intentions.text: I can delete an author from the system.
intentions.observable: the author is removed from the author list and all posts associated with them are no longer attributed to that author

intentions.text: I can add a new tag to the system.
intentions.observable: the tag appears in the list of tags

intentions.text: I can remove a tag from a post.
intentions.requires: a post identifier and a tag name
intentions.observable: the tag is no longer listed in the post's tags
